R03 equal 300k fixture is independent synthetic regression only.

review/start checks current revision, pinned scope and exact connection_ref/verified_generation/account+target, profile, permission, stable effect key. Start atomic immutable accept/idempotency ledger. EXEC checks current authorized connection and exclusive worker lease; same account alone insufficient. No public runtime handle/token. Worker lease generation may change independently of verified auth binding.

each potentially mutating operation uses stable logical operation ID+target tuple+binding, admitted durably before dispatch; no duplicate/unknown retry. Read step is scoped. Any unexpected error/condition loss after start => stopping→stopped, pending becomes unknown if absence not proven; no user cancel/resume/rollback.

goal observation must match trusted evidence record and exact approved target/profile goal/method/state, observed canonical payload digest (from actual readback, not approved-input copy), asset digests if required; all required steps and effects verified; no unknown effect for done. If insufficient evidence => unknown, not_reached only known no goal-capable effect or authoritative absence. Preserve error/unknown and late proof, not reopen.

state and response invariants: prestart ready is derived, unsupported/blocked never ready; review only ready+verified+new; terminal result required and done confirmed; stopped never resumes. Owner-only data/public evidence redaction. GET no external mutation.

wire_compatibility.notes: Retain V3 candidate paths and input/output type names from common schema V4. CO maps AuthOutput to AuthResponse without internal connection/target identity or secret; viewer grant only auth open/refresh. Review digest binds internal scope, public ReviewView shows actual values and target label, no internal connection. Schema root must not be used as validation; select named definition. All existing semantic S01~S12 stay except V4 explicitly replaces field shapes, price/VAT meaning, platform enums, and connection/evidence boundaries.

canonical.rule: Use server canonical UTF-8 sorted-key JSON, integer safe range, order arrays, preserve Unicode, SHA256. Profile content excludes self digest; scope digest exact internal Scope; payload digest exact platform values excluding transport-only source/approval/connection refs; when platform observations normalize to canonical values, profile defines same mapping; asset digest list in upload order. Test vectors and implementation must match; no client-supplied hash authority.
